name: Lovely GAL
source:
"Get three hidden treasures, then the door to another world will be opened" - said the mysterious old man. If you manage to collect the famous sword, secret medicine and ancient documents you may try to enter there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“集齐三件隐藏的秘宝，通往异世界的大门便会开启。”神秘老人说道。只要找齐名剑、秘药和古代文书，你便可以尝试进入那里。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
